caption: AI doesn’t build the right swing, but it can build the wrong one ten times faster.

why-the-line-gets-out-of-balance.header: Why the line gets out of balance
why-the-line-gets-out-of-balance.description: DORA's 2025 report overview says AI's primary role is as an amplifier, magnifying an organization's existing strengths and weaknesses, and that the greatest returns come from a focus on the organizational system rather than the tools. It is an overview page; the report text was not read [1].

dora-2025-overview.title: DORA, State of AI-assisted Software Development 2025 (overview page)

the-hook.title: The Hook
the-hook.script: That is the sentence from a moment ago: ten wrong swings, built faster. Keep it in mind, because the rest of this Episode is about why it is true and what you do about it.

cartoon-to-balanced-line.title: Cartoon to balanced line
cartoon-to-balanced-line.script: Now picture the cartoon turning into a real factory line. Input comes in at a constant rate, every station keeps pace with the next, the output is steady and the quality is high. If this was how your organization worked, you would not need this Episode.

reality.title: Reality
reality.script: But you know it does not work like that, because you have seen what happens when every station is pushed to go faster. Bottlenecks form, documents queue up in front of one station while the next one sits idle. Efficiency, effectiveness and multiplication are the three dials on this line: turn them all up, and the line stops flowing. So look at the line you work in and ask yourself: which station is yours?
